purpose: Frozen model/task comparison required by results/laya_decision_v3/laya_v3_task_adaptation_final_decision_v1.json (required_followup: separately versioned model/task comparison or redesign study).
research_question: Under the frozen task-adaptation contract v1, does the typed-decisions checkpoint satisfy the frozen behavioral gates at a level comparable to the english checkpoint when both are run under one identical protocol on one new synthetic comparison set?
scope_statement: Synthetic contract comparison only; the oracles are not real-world ground truth and no claim is made about real-runtime policy quality. The bundle-subfolder route for typed-decisions is recorded; weight equivalence with the standalone convaiinnovations/laya-typed-decisions repository is not claimed.

baseline_context_only.note: V3.1 english-only baseline; its cases (VAL-01..30) are NOT reused and its numbers are context only.

question_construction.source: contract.questions in the contract freeze, sha-verified at runtime
question_construction.rule: For each contract question q the runner passes {type: q.type, instructions: q.instructions, criteria: <ordered map>} and does not pass criteria_order or any other contract-level fields. Ordering follows contract.criteria_order (canonical) for evidence_state and strategy. evidence_ref has no static criteria: the runner builds a map with one entry per supplied document id, sorted lexicographically by doc_id, each mapping to 'Supplied document <doc_id>', followed by 'NONE' mapping to 'No supplied document is adequate.'; when a case supplies no documents the map contains only NONE.
question_construction.determinism: runtime question defs are derived mechanically and are identical for both arms and all runs

execution.integrity: runner verifies sha256 of contract freeze, comparison set and this protocol before any model call; both checkpoint digests passed to the Router for on-load verification; abort on any mismatch

schedule.run_index: 1 for all cases; 1..3 for repeat subset cases

execution.recording: per call: case_id, arm, run_index, raw answers object, routing object, latency_ms, schema_valid, allow_list_valid, evidence_ref_valid, enforced {action, strategy, evidence_refs}
execution.failure_handling: Abort on technical failure (input digest mismatch, model load error, Router exception) and rerun the full study in one session after the cause is fixed. Model outputs are recorded as-is, including malformed output; no call is retried for behavioral reasons and no call is dropped.

caller_enforcement: Implements contract.caller_rules mechanically after predict, before metrics: INSUFFICIENT or CONFLICTING evidence_state -> ABSTAIN with strategy baseline and empty evidence_refs; SUFFICIENT with evidence_ref NONE, or with a ref that is not a supplied document id, or with malformed answers -> ABSTAIN with baseline and empty evidence_refs; only SUFFICIENT with a valid supplied-document ref may yield SELECT with that ref. Confidence is never used to override (UNCALIBRATED_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; no threshold).

metrics.basis: computed over primary calls only (run_index 1); repeat calls used only for repeatability and latency descriptives

definitions.schema_validity: fraction of calls whose answers contain all three question ids with type=choice, a string choice label present in that question's criteria labels, and a non-empty numeric probabilities map
definitions.allow_list_compliance: fraction of calls whose chosen labels all belong to the canonical label sets (3 evidence states, 7 strategies, supplied document ids plus NONE)
definitions.evidence_reference_validity: fraction of calls whose raw evidence_ref choice is a supplied document id or NONE
definitions.evidence_state_contract_alignment: fraction of the 30 primary calls whose raw evidence_state choice equals the oracle evidence_state
definitions.required_abstain_recall: over the 10 required-abstain cases, fraction with enforced action ABSTAIN
definitions.inappropriate_abstain_rate_on_sufficient: over the 20 sufficient cases, fraction with enforced action ABSTAIN
definitions.strategy_compatibility_on_sufficient: over the 20 sufficient cases, fraction with enforced action SELECT whose enforced strategy is in oracle.allowed_strategies
definitions.evidence_reference_compatibility_on_suff: over the 20 sufficient cases, fraction with enforced action SELECT whose enforced evidence_ref is in oracle.allowed_evidence_refs
definitions.repeatability: for each repeat-subset case, all 3 enforced outputs identical; repeatability_all_stable is true when all 6 cases are stable
definitions.latency_ms: wall-clock per predict call; mean, median, p90, min, max; descriptive only, no gate

classification.control_reporting: gates and metrics are computed and reported for both arms; classification is driven by the candidate arm; the english arm is the reference baseline

boundaries: no commit without explicit user authorization
no post-hoc threshold, case, or definition changes; any change requires new versioned files and a fresh full run
no reuse of VAL-01..30 or any prior RAGIN cases or model outputs
no real-runtime holdout or deployment claim from this synthetic comparison
no fusion or integration implementation in this study; that remains gated on the outcome
single run of the frozen study; results published whether passing or failing
immutability: This protocol and the comparison set are immutable from the moment of the first model call. Deviations are documented as versioned amendments with a new protocol and a fresh full run.
